desc: The Universal Bipod Mount(UBM) was designed to be a secure mounting solution for the majority of Harris or Picatinny style bipods. The UBM features 8 Pic rail sections with a narrow center section allowing for an integrated Harris-style bipod mount. The UBM is the solution for real-world shooting environments that require shooter adaptation on the fly. Installation is simple: just use the existing holes in the bottom of the stock with the provided mounting screws. If your stock has only one sling stud another can be easily installed using any T-nut and Allen screw found at most hardware stores.
